title: 588. Minesweeper

examples.explanation: A blank region floods outward until it touches numbered squares bordering the mine.
The clicked square hides a mine, so it is marked X.

hints: Handle the mine click first: M becomes X with no further changes.
For an empty square, count mines in all 8 neighboring cells before deciding between a digit and B.

Only blank (zero-neighbor) squares trigger recursion into still-unrevealed E neighbors; join each finished row into one answer string. Adaptation: the board is a char_array_2d input while the updated board is returned as row strings (string_list). Rust note: the board arrives as its encoded string; parse it before solving.
